articles.title: High school soccer: Springville halts OT jinx on Elizabeth Hopkins’ golden goal against Timpview
articles.summary: High school soccer: Springville halts OT jinx on Elizabeth Hopkins’ golden goal against Timpview
articles.body:
As a way to inject a little fun into practice this week, Springville coach Todd Hollingshead had his players work on their diving headers.

The opportunity to actually attempt a diving header in a game is extremely rare, so the drill was primarily just a funny way to do some team bonding while enhancing on a very little used skill.

Incredibly though, Springville defender Elizabeth Hopkins put that skill to great use on Thursday night, scoring the overtime winner against Timpview on such a shot.

The sophomore headed in Sarah Penrod's corner kick in the final minute of the first overtime to seal her team's 2-1 win over Timpview for the very rare overtime win for the Red Devils — who came into the game 0-6 in overtime and shootouts this season.

"It's mostly a fun thing, but they kind of learn how to head it, and that's what she did," Hollingshead said. "It was a diving header so we were all kind of celebrating that, but she's the kind of player that will just throw her body on the line.

"She doesn't care. She's running through all that traffic, and she dives and she got to that ball first."

Hopkins said the whole sequence was chaotic, but when she looked up after her shot and saw the ball in the net, "Oh my gosh, It was amazing, and then I just like got jumped on. I was like, 'I can't breathe.' I'm just under here and I can't breathe," she said with laughter.

The goal was Hopkins' first of the season, and helped Springville continue its strong form late in the season.

With all those overtime and shootout losses this season — three of each — the Red Devils came into Thursday's game with a 7-8 overall record and a 4-6 record in Region 7. But they've won four of their past five, with just one game remaining in the regular season.

Despite the constant up and down, Hollingshead said he's been extremely proud of how his players have never lost sight of the bigger picture. They have kept coming to practice and putting in the work every day, even when results were hard to come by.

"The girls continued to believe in each other and play for each other. It's so easy when you lose in overtime to let that wear you down, but the girls have been great. They've stayed really positive," said Hollingshead.

"We kind of told the girls all along, 'We know you're a talented team. You know you're a talented team. Just believe in each other. Give 100% effort, and then we'll have a real chance to finish strong.' So, I think that's what it is. They just believe in themselves."

A big part of Springville's success Thursday night was matching Timpview's intensity throughout the game, and then exceeding it late in the match.

After Timpview equalized early in the second half on a goal from Ava Badger, Springville wrestled back momentum by being the more dangerous team late in the second half.

That continued into overtime, as Hopkins' goal was ultimately the result of sustained pressure over several minutes.

Trevi Jackson nearly scored the golden goal a minute earlier on a breakaway, but Timpview's keeper made a great save to deflect the shot just wide of the post. On the ensuring corner kick, Springville maintained possession in a dangerous area to win a second corner, with Hopkins ultimately burying the winner.

"Soccer's an interesting sport. You can kind of feel it when you're watching. In that second half, Timpview came out, and you could sense that they were kind of controlling. They were getting more looks at goal, and they were being more aggressive. You can kind of sense something's coming, nd then they got the goal," said Hollingshead.

"And you could see in that overtime, that momentum was with us, and we just kept going and going."

Until Thursday night, Springville hadn't capitalized on that momentum in overtime. With the Red Devils' growing confidence though, they'll be a very dangerous team to deal with in the playoffs.

Springville's Penrod opened the scoring 13 minutes into the match as she buried a cross from Savannah Johnston for the early 1-0 lead.

articles.title: La nueva camiseta de la selección de Cataluña elimina la barra que le sobraba por error: "Son cuatro barras"
articles.summary: La FCF (Federació Catalana de Futbol) ha presentado la nueva camiseta de la selección de fútbol de Cataluña.
articles.body: La FCF (Federació Catalana de Futbol) ha presentado la nueva camiseta de la selección de fútbol de Cataluña. "Catalunya són quatre barres (Cataluña son cuatro barras", informa la FCT apuntando que recuperan las cuatro barras tradicionales de la 'senyera' (bandera de nueve franjas horizontales, cinco amarillas y cuatro rojas que es la bandera oficial de la comunidad autónoma autónoma). En la camiseta anterior la selección de Cataluña lució cinco barras en su camiseta por un error de fabricación. "Hubo un fallo de producción con la última camiseta y esta vez hemos vigilado que no haya ningún fallo de fabricación y que realmente sean las cuatro barras", declaró Joan Soteras, presidente de la FCF, en la presentación de la "nueva piel de Cataluña".

articles.title: 'Pértiga Gate' en LaLiga: "Todos lo entrenadores lo hacen, y el que diga lo contrario miente"
articles.summary: Luis García Plaza, entrenador del Sevilla, habló en el programa El Partidazo de COPE sobre su polémica con los micrófonos en las pausas de hidratación.
articles.body: Luis García Plaza, entrenador del Sevilla, habló en el programa El Partidazo de COPE sobre su polémica con los micrófonos en las pausas de hidratación. "Tengo a una persona escuchando lo que dice el entrenador contrario (en las pausas de hidratación) para transmitírmelo a través del móvil... Todos los entrenadores lo hacen, y el entrenador que diga lo contrario está mintiendo", le contó a Juanma Castaño. En el partido contra el Valencia el técnico del Sevilla se encaró con el micrófono de DAZN durante una pausa de hidratación. "¡Es que no quiero que se entere el equipo contrario de lo que voy a decir, ya está, sólo eso!", exclamó Luis García Plaza en dos ocasiones, insistiendo en su disgusto con que una conversación de carácter táctico pudiera ser recogida por el sonido ambiente de la retransmisión. El técnico cerró el corrillo en torno a él y comenzó su charla explicando cómo estaba dispuesto el Valencia, pero luego bajó el volumen de la voz y no se oyó nada más de forma inteligible.

articles.body:
Manchester United Women have been steadily improving lately.

They originally struggled when Eva Olid came in as manager, failing to win any of their pre-season matches.

The Red Devils also lost their first two games of the season against London City Lionesses and Chelsea.

Nonetheless, they have roared back since drawing an impressive match against Arsenal and winning three on the spin, including a 10-1 demolition of Sheffield United.

The latest victory was a 5-1 thrashing of Durham in the Players' Cup.

The club's website reports that, "Manchester United can confirm that Jose Herrera has joined as assistant head coach for Manchester United Women."

The article adds, "Herrera will now work alongside Gavin Beith and Dan Bale supporting Eva Olid."

This means that Scott Rogers will leave the role of assistant manager, having only been appointed in 2025.

Herrera has a strong professional background in Spain as a head coach and will certainly bring a lot of know-how to the role.

United's site describes him as a "talented young coach, who began his career at the age of 16 and holds a UEFA Pro Licence."

The 36-year-old worked as Málaga CF Femenino head coach in 2019 before leaving for Granada in 2020.

He then spent three seasons at UD Tenerife until 2024. He was originally an assistant but became head coach of the side in 2023.

In the 2024-2025 season, he took the chance to manage abroad and worked as Al-Hilal Women's team head coach.

Herrera took over the role of Atletico Madrid women manager in January this year and got his team to the final of La Copa de la Reina, but they lost 1-3 to eventual champions FC Barcelona.

He also lost 0-5 on aggregate to Manchester United last year in the last 16 of the Champions League.
